name: comp-108
title: Button Group With Menu
blurb: Grouped buttons for Files, Media, plus a menu ellipsis button.
description: Three tightly-grouped outline buttons: two labeled buttons with icons and a menu button with ellipsis icon. Buttons are grouped with negative margins and rounded edges.
use_when: Providing quick access to common actions with an overflow menu.
avoid_when: When you need the menu to actually open a dropdown (component is presentation only).
a11y: Uses aria-label on the menu button and aria-hidden on icons. Focus ring z-index prevents overlap.
